cli.argument_closure: Exactly one fixtures value; exactly one report only for verify-report; no report for prepare-report/admit-benchmark; no abbreviations/help/arbitrary command/hash/ref/env authority.
cli.refusal: exit1; empty stdout; fixed opaque stderr without traceback
cli.success: exit0; canonical JSON+LF on stdout only; empty stderr

evidence_limits: Synthetic engineering benchmark only; no retrieval/vector storage/model/tokenization/quality/cost/fairness/installation or scientific promotion.
Existing dated contract/README/plan statuses remain historical; runtime and source review are distinct.

replaces_only: admitted_corpus now requires strict frozen benchmark admission
prospective_scope.runtime_status: Captured and mounted documentation under the current workflow; not read/executed by product/CLI admission logic, not admission authority and not a candidate bypass. Actual source-bound run outcomes remain separate records.
prospective_scope.v1_reports: The new CLI emits/recomputes report version2. Prior closed version1 reports are historical and fail exact verify-report recomputation; generate a fresh version2 structural report. This extension does not retroactively reinterpret old receipts.

strict_reference.API: admitted_corpus calls the same admit_benchmark gate, returning corpus rows only on strict success.
strict_reference.authority: Reviewed product literal, never a supplied report/manifest/hash/environment/path. Recompute from the same validated manifest/documents/raw byte snapshot used for the returned projection; no second fixture read.
strict_reference.canonical_json: UTF8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+LF; arrays ordered; no Unicode/newline normalization
strict_reference.compatibility: Formatting/key order of JSON and an inert sentinel-only change preserve semantic identity after raw transport descriptors are coherently rebound. Structural safety, duplicate-key/type/inventory/hash/span checks and decoded sentinel leak scan still precede fingerprinting. Coherent corpus/query/answer/order/span changes may remain structurally valid but cannot be admitted as this frozen original.

preimage.corpus: manifest source order of content_ref, actual captured byte length and SHA256
preimage.manifest: complete parsed manifest except case_files raw transport descriptors

strict_reference.verify_report: Recomputes the complete canonical structural v2 report with admitted=false. Supplied admitted=true cannot confer strict admission.
